column1: # [SONNET-4.6] sq-lhcot.2 (#2789) DRAFT external-key .spqv profile conformance corpus.
# Profile: research/spqv-external-key-profile.md. Regenerate: generate.py (see its header).
# An `accept` row's detail column is prose; a `reject` row's is a REQUIRED error substring:
# a conforming parser must refuse the fixture AND say why. Columns are tab-separated;
# `-` means not-applicable. Cross-repository consumers read this file, not the .rs test.

column6: an empty table is well-formed: a producer with no external keys yet still declares its (code, length) profile
the canonical shape: three 32-byte keys in ascending digest order
an external key is generation-independent but NOT embedding-space-independent, so the table binds the embedding provenance
the signature area round-trips as OPAQUE bytes; no implementation verifies it under the draft profile, and its presence asserts nothing
a 64-byte digest at the length cap — the entry width is derived from the header, never assumed to be 32
